items.q: What does a website at SaaleWeb cost?
items.a: A landing page starts at €990, company websites at €1,990. You always get a transparent fixed price after a free initial call.
A landing page is often ready in 1–2 weeks, a full company website in 3–5 weeks — depending on scope and content.
Yes. SEO is part of every website from the start — technical, content and local — so you're found on Google and in AI search.
We structure your content so that ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity can understand, cite and recommend your business.
From the Business package you get a simple CMS to update texts, images and blog posts yourself.

items.q: Do you offer hosting and maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We host on Vercel (lightning-fast and secure) and offer optional maintenance with updates, monitoring and support.
